title: Kid-Made Masterpiece Major Update
summary: The portfolio got its biggest personality jump yet with a more personal voice, a giant homepage major-update section, and upgraded release notes that treat the site like a real evolving creation.
items: Reworked the homepage tone so the site feels more like Krishiv speaking and less like a generic AI-written product page.
Added a full major-update spotlight section that makes the site feel like a huge real release instead of a tiny patch.
Upgraded the release-notes page with a latest-release spotlight and major-release highlighting.
Turned the whole update into a real v5.0.0 launch across the homepage and permanent release history.

title: Initial Portfolio Launch
summary: The first live version of the portfolio went online with the core homepage, projects, and creator identity.
items: Published the first public site structure and portfolio identity.
Established the first project showcase and contact flow.
Created the base for future app pages and creator expansion.

title: App Suite Expansion
summary: The site grew from a portfolio into a larger app ecosystem with more tools, concept pages, and stronger contact coverage.
items: Expanded the portfolio app suite with new student and creator tool ideas.
Refreshed the contact area for better discovery and outreach.
Pushed the site toward a wider multi-page product feel.

title: Sync Stability Upgrade
summary: Core portfolio app flows and sync behavior were stabilized so live systems felt more reliable.
items: Fixed sync lag issues across connected portfolio systems.
Improved reliability for app flows tied to live data.
Reduced weak points in the portfolio control flow.

title: Project Operations Dashboard Launch
summary: A protected operations dashboard was added to manage and inspect the project more like a real product.
items: Added the protected operations dashboard route and UI.
Created a stronger control surface for project operations.
Moved toward product-grade management instead of static admin pages.

title: Operations Launcher Controls Expansion
summary: The private operations dashboard became more capable with richer launcher and control actions.
items: Expanded private launcher controls for faster operations.
Improved utility and navigation inside the private surface.
Made it easier to act on project workflows in one place.

title: Operations Experience Polish
summary: Typography, layout polish, and dashboard sync consistency were tightened across the private operations experience.
items: Refined typography and visual rhythm in the private dashboard.
Synced private controls across the live site for consistency.
Improved overall clarity and readability.

title: Ops Audits and Command Center Upgrade
summary: The private command center evolved into a more complete operational surface with audits and app state controls.
items: Added private audits and stronger app state controls.
Expanded the private command center for broader project oversight.
Improved confidence when managing live systems.

title: Aether Local Math Engine
summary: Aether builds gained instant math and equation solving locally before the Gemini fallback.
items: Added a local math solver for arithmetic and simple equations.
Kept non-math prompts routed to Gemini.
Removed visible local-routing labels so answers stay natural.

title: Gemini Key Pool Rotation
summary: The Google AI backend moved from a single-key pattern to a rotating key pool with failover.
items: Added a shared Google API key pool for backend AI requests.
Rotated requests across keys to spread load.
Prepared the backend for stronger uptime during higher usage.

title: Quota Saver AI Routing
summary: The AI backend became health-aware and started cooling down stressed keys instead of burning through them.
items: Tracked per-key health in memory.
Added cooldowns for rate-limited or failing keys.
Preferred healthier keys to preserve the overall pool.

title: Platform Control Center Major Update
summary: The website became more like a connected product ecosystem with live platform stats, AI mesh reporting, and a stronger launcher experience.
items: Added a public platform overview endpoint for live ecosystem data.
Upgraded the shared app launcher with favorites, recents, featured builds, and quick actions.
Expanded the homepage Command Center with AI Mesh and Launch Radar panels.

title: App Identity and Release System Upgrade
summary: The app gallery became clearer and more complete with working-app labels, SVG icon coverage, and stronger public navigation.
items: Added SVG icons for every app shown in the homepage gallery, including concept builds.
Changed live app chips to clearer working-app labels so usable builds stand out instantly.
Expanded the public web map with the all-links directory, nav search, and matching release-note coverage.

title: Concept Apps Promoted to Working Apps
summary: Former concept cards were promoted into the working app lineup so the gallery now treats them as usable apps instead of placeholders.
items: Removed concept-only labeling from the promoted app cards.
Reclassified those builds into the working app tier for filtering and stats.
Updated gallery wording so the site presents them as real apps across the homepage and launcher.

title: AI Prompt History Recall
summary: Core AI pages now remember earlier prompts so people can bring messages back with keyboard shortcuts instead of retyping them.
items: Added prompt recall with ArrowUp and Tab on Aether v104, v55, and v2.5.
Added saved prompt-set recall in Idea Lab AI for goal, audience, and constraints together.
Stored recent prompt history locally in the browser for faster repeat use.

title: Aether Core v110 Fusion Launch
summary: A new Aether public build launched with the strongest features from v2.5, v55, and v104 combined into one richer AI command page.
items: Launched Aether Core v110 with multi-mode reasoning, node mesh routing, quick prompt packs, and prompt recall.
Added file-context loading with plain text and PPTX support so prompts can use uploaded content directly.
Integrated v110 across the public launcher, homepage gallery, links directory, and project listings.
